verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found an OpenAPI document served at motherduck.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, containing an "openapi" key), so a machine-readable API spec can be downloaded directly. Nothing in the pack documents what the spec covers or how it is maintained; llms.txt is machine-readable but is a docs index, not an API spec. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec's scope and versioning, evidence of which API surface it covers, independent corroboration.
